new_candidates.body:
See https://formulae.brew.sh/formula/python@3.15.

We should switch our default Python on macOS to the latest Python, which is 3.15.

This would be the version used for our `*.tar.gz` binaries, as well as for developer builds with Bazel.
new_candidates.title: Bump macOS to Python 3.15

new_candidates.body:
We'd like to claim support for Python 3.15 in our wheel releases https://drake.mit.edu/pip.html.

Doing that requires testing against Python 3.15, so we should add 3.15 to our wheel test matrix during the wheel build.

We do NOT need to build/test 3.15 against pybind11; rather only test against nanobind.
new_candidates.title: Add wheel support for Python 3.15

new_candidates.body:
### Description

When Isaac Sim is started without the ROS 2 environment (`LD_LIBRARY_PATH` not containing `exts/isaacsim.ros2.core/humble/lib`), the ROS 2 bridge fails to load. Isaac Sim logs the failure but keeps running. Setting `inputs:messageName` on a `isaacsim.ros2.bridge.ROS2Subscriber` node afterwards then crashes the whole process with a native SIGSEGV, instead of raising an error. I would expect a Python exception (or at least a logged error) here, not a crash that takes the process down.

Two smaller observations from the same log, stated as observed, without a claim about the cause:
- The fallback message says it is "falling back to internal libraries", then tries to load `<isaac-sim>/exts/isaacsim.ros2.core/humble/liblibrosidl_runtime_c.so`. That file does not exist. The library is at `<isaac-sim>/exts/isaacsim.ros2.core/humble/lib/librosidl_runtime_c.so`.
- The startup failure is logged, but the app keeps running with the bridge unloaded.

**Minimal reproduction** (headless, no ROS 2 environment sourced: `ROS_DISTRO`, `AMENT_PREFIX_PATH`, `RMW_IMPLEMENTATION` and `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` are unset in the launching shell):

```python
# repro.py -- run with: ./python.sh repro.py
from isaacsim import SimulationApp
app = SimulationApp({"headless": True})

import omni.kit.app, omni.graph.core as og, omni.usd

em = omni.kit.app.get_app().get_extension_manager()
em.set_extension_enabled_immediate("isaacsim.ros2.bridge", True)

omni.usd.get_context().new_stage()
keys = og.Controller.Keys
graph, (sub,), _, _ = og.Controller.edit(
    {"graph_path": "/G", "evaluator_name": "execution"},
    {keys.CREATE_NODES: [("Sub", "isaacsim.ros2.bridge.ROS2Subscriber")]},
)
for name, value in [("topicName", "/x"), ("messagePackage", "sensor_msgs"),
                    ("messageSubfolder", "msg"), ("messageName", "JointState")]:
    print("SET", name, value, flush=True)
    og.Controller.attribute(f"inputs:{name}", sub).set(value)
print("OK done", flush=True)
app.close()
```

Result: the first three `SET` lines print, then `SET messageName JointState` prints, then the process dies with `Segmentation fault (core dumped)`. `OK done` is never printed.

Relevant log lines before the crash:

```
Checking to see if RMW can be loaded:
failed to get symbol 'rmw_init_options_init' due to Environment variable 'AMENT_PREFIX_PATH' is not set or empty, ...
RMW was not loaded
[Error] [isaacsim.ros2.core.impl.extension] ROS2 Bridge startup failed
...
Could not load the dynamic library from librosidl_runtime_c.so. Error: librosidl_runtime_c.so: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
Loading librosidl_runtime_c.so from sourced ROS_DISTRO failed, falling back to internal libraries.
Could not load the dynamic library from <isaac-sim>/exts/isaacsim.ros2.core/humble/liblibrosidl_runtime_c.so. Error: ... cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
[Warning] [isaacsim.ros2.core.plugin] Could not load ROS2 Bridge due to missing library dependencies, please make sure your sourced ROS2 workspace has the correct packages/libraries installed
```

**Native backtrace** (gdb, Isaac Sim 6.0.1, no symbols available for the plugin frames):

```
Thread 1 "python3" received signal SIGSEGV, Segmentation fault.
#0  0x... in ?? () from .../exts/isaacsim.ros2.nodes/.../bin/libisaacsim.ros2.nodes.plugin.so
#1  0x... in ?? () from .../exts/isaacsim.ros2.nodes/.../bin/libisaacsim.ros2.nodes.plugin.so
#2  0x... in ?? () from .../omni.graph.core-3.1.2+.../bin/libomni.graph.core.plugin.so
#3  0x... in ?? () from .../omni.graph.core-3.1.2+.../bin/libomni.graph.core.plugin.so
#4  0x... in ?? () from .../omni/graph/core/_omni_graph_core.cpython-312-x86_64-linux-gnu.so
...
```

The Python-side stack written by Kit's crash reporter for this script ends at the `.set(value)` line of the loop (`repro.py:15`).

**Workaround / comparison.** Starting Isaac Sim with the environment from `setup_ros_env.sh` makes the same script finish (`OK done`) on 6.0.1:

```
ROS_DISTRO=humble RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_fastrtps_cpp \
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=<isaac-sim>/exts/isaacsim.ros2.core/humble/lib ./python.sh repro.py
```

With that environment, the full workflow I was running (a ROS2Subscriber/ROS2Publisher graph for a gripper, driven from an external rclpy process) also works. I only observed the crash in the state where the bridge failed to load, and I understand that Isaac Sim expects the environment to be set. The report is that, in that state, the result is a native crash rather than an error.

**Also checked on Isaac Sim 6.2.0-rc.14:** `./python.sh --no-ros-env repro.py` logs `ROS2 Bridge startup failed`, the same `liblibrosidl_runtime_c.so` lookup path, and the `Could not load ROS2 Bridge due to missing library dependencies` warning, then ends in `Segmentation fault`, with `OK done` never printed. I did not take a gdb backtrace on 6.2.0. By default, 6.2.0's `python.sh` sources `setup_ros_env.sh` (not tested on 6.0.1, whose `python.sh` does not), which is why the plain run there did not crash.

I did not get 6.1.0 to run my script (it failed at startup for an unrelated reason), so I make no claim about it.

### Isaac Sim version

6.0.1 (`6.0.1-rc.7+release.42383.32955d8d.gl`; `isaacsim.ros2.bridge` 5.1.2, `isaacsim.ros2.core` 1.9.4, `isaacsim.ros2.nodes` 1.18.13). Also reproduced with `--no-ros-env` on 6.2.0-rc.14+release.52805.02189a84.gl (`isaacsim.ros2.bridge` 5.1.4, `isaacsim.ros2.core` 1.11.2, `isaacsim.ros2.nodes` 1.22.9).

### Operating System (OS)

Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS

### GPU Name

NVIDIA RTX 2000 Ada Generation Laptop GPU

### GPU Driver and CUDA versions

Driver 595.99.02, CUDA 13.2
new_candidates.title: ROS2Subscriber: setting messageName segfaults (libisaacsim.ros2.nodes.plugin.so) when the ROS 2 bridge failed to load
